description: Fix block-0 pre-attention LayerNorm scales to one in nearest-neutral order
proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 28 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0059 at 2,118 parameters/99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0119, whose block-1 pre-attention scale coordinate 4 scored 96.55% at 1,671 parameters. The block-0 site retains all 16 learned scales; its nearest-to-one coordinate is 4 at 1.143266. Hypothesis: block-specific scaling sensitivity may differ even though block 1 failed, and neutral fixing tests a different constraint from attempt-0096's failed pairwise scale union. The helper orders scales by distance to one, fixes one per micro-trial, and delegates all acceptance/rollback to the official runner. Stop on first scored discard or error, no coordinate, 16 micro-trials, or 22 wall-clock minutes. This is more informative than another block-1 coordinate because it isolates site and constraint type.
